column1: # What each adapter actually installs. One row per capability; `|` separated.
# Declarative on purpose: install.sh check prints this next to live PASS/FAIL lines, so a row
# that stops being true shows up as a visible discrepancy. Update it when you add an adapter.
Extras|claude-extras.md loaded by the shim|not wired: no documented import|not wired: no documented import
Skills|managed links into ~/.claude/skills|managed links into ~/.agents/skills|not installed: no skills contract
External skills|portable and Claude-only locked sources|portable locked sources only|not installed: no skills contract
Source check|offline cache, selection and ownership|offline cache, selection and ownership|not applicable
Detection|claude on PATH or ~/.claude exists|codex on PATH or ~/.codex exists|gemini on PATH or ~/.gemini exists
Verify|shim content compared as text (a trailing-newline-only difference is ignored)|link target compared|link target compared
Provenance|tracked copy: sha256 recorded, drift fails check|managed symlink: no second copy to drift|managed symlink: no second copy to drift
Backup|in-the-way file moved, never deleted|in-the-way file moved, never deleted|in-the-way file moved, never deleted
